videos.title: 🎬 Video URLs or IDs
videos.description: Watch, youtu.be, Shorts, live URLs or bare video IDs. Channel/playlist URLs pasted here are expanded too.

channels.title: 📺 Channels or playlists
channels.description: Channel URLs or @handles (latest videos; add /shorts or /streams) and playlist URLs.

searchTerms.title: 🔎 Search terms
searchTerms.description: Get transcripts of the top video results for these YouTube searches.

maxVideosPerSource.title: Max videos per channel / playlist / search
maxVideosPerSource.description: How many videos to take from each channel, playlist or search term.

maxVideos.title: Max videos in total (optional)
maxVideos.description: Hard cap on videos processed (and charged) in this run.

languages.title: Preferred languages
languages.description: Language codes in order of preference, e.g. en, es, de, pl, pt-BR.

preferManualCaptions.title: Prefer human-made captions
preferManualCaptions.description: Use creator-uploaded captions when available, otherwise auto-generated.

fallbackToAnyLanguage.title: Fallback to any available language
fallbackToAnyLanguage.description: If none of your languages exist, return the video's original-language transcript.

includeTimestamps.title: Include timestamped segments
includeTimestamps.description: Adds a segments array: start, duration, text.

includeVideosWithoutTranscript.title: Output videos without transcript (free)
includeVideosWithoutTranscript.description: Adds a free row with an error flag for videos that have no captions (or other non-charged errors). On by default, so no-caption videos show up as error items instead of disappearing from the dataset.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy (datacenter) is used by default.

residentialFallback.title: Residential proxy fallback
residentialFallback.description: Retry blocked videos through residential proxy (no extra cost to you).
